remaining_findings.explanation: The bulk lookup builds its filter before acquiring the client, property and parsed dates. The CFG reverses that dependency, permitting settings reads and client initialization before a filter failure that would precede those effects in the source.

The inspection request summary places inspectionUrl and siteUrl at the top level. The source passes both fields inside requestBody, so the represented delivery payload differs from the actual API argument.

Unavailable dotenv internals do not prevent representing the visible zero-argument configuration call and its possible environment initialization effect. Marking the entire boundary unmodeled loses the call-origin environment post-state; exact loading success and precedence can remain unresolved.

The gaps for calls such as ir_057, ir_086, ir_098, ir_107, ir_323 and ir_359 stop propagation solely because an internal invocation-link primitive is unavailable. These zero-argument getSettings calls have fully visible implementations and can use occurrence-specific summaries with the existing read and compute operations. Their acquired settings versions need not be linked to an independently declared execution.

Cache checks read the separate location caches, while initialization, successful construction and reset write ga4_cache, search_cache and indexing_cache. No declared relation connects those locations, so the represented cache checks do not consume the bindings changed by those writes.

The URL-child summary names client acquisition in prose but declares no cache read, conditional initialization acquisition or cache update. Its normal notification computation also lacks the clock input used when the acquired notification time is falsy. Separate callee declarations and precision-gap prose do not propagate these effects into this loop occurrence.

Inspection extraction and projection are treated as unavailable, although the complete body supplies their paths, defaults and returned fields. The opaque assembly additionally consumes the original API specification, introducing a possible original-URL dependency absent from the source result construction. Known forwarding of inspectionResultLink, canonical URLs, last-crawl information and optional component contents remains unresolved unnecessarily.

The annotation repeatedly claims that concrete GA4 row-value paths are absent and therefore retains only report structure or outbound request demands. Both response interfaces visibly declare rows[].dimensionValues[].value and rows[].metricValues[].value. Shape alone does not express the required returned measurements at report, comparison and aggregate receivers.

Dimension and metric discovery demand the whole acquired collection by value. Their contracts require all entries with apiName, uiName and description; completeness of membership does not establish necessity of arbitrary additional acquired entry members. The independent full-property-metadata contract does explicitly require its whole response.

The requestIndexingBatch receiver has a cardinality demand and per-member value demands but no demand preserving input order. A permutation can satisfy those demands while violating the faithful Task's ordered-result requirement.
